arxiv-2308-08706.title: Bures geodesics and quantum metrology
arxiv-2308-08706.creator: Dominique Spehner
arxiv-2308-08706.description: Abstract We study the geodesics on the manifold of mixed quantum states for the Bures metric. It is shown that these geodesics correspond to physical non-Markovian evolutions of the system coupled to an ancilla. Furthermore, we argue that geodesics lead to optimal precision in single-parameter estimation in quantum metrology.

arxiv-2412-17407.title: Deuteron gravitational form factors, generalized parton distributions, and charge density in the framework of the soft-wall AdS/QCD model
arxiv-2412-17407.creator: Shahin Mamedov
arxiv-2412-17407.description: Abstract Abstract We study gravitational deuteron form factors (GFF) and generalized parton distributions (GPDs) within the soft-wall AdS/QCD model, where deuteron is described by the bulk vector field with twist \tau=6 . For finite-temperature studies, we apply the soft-wall model, which is thermalized by introducing a thermal dilaton field.

pmc-10737957.title: FEASIBILITY AND ACCEPTABILITY OF INSPIRATORY MUSCLE STRENGTH TRAINING AMONG OLDER ADULTS IN MYSORE, INDIA
pmc-10737957.creator: Raghavi karnam, Nagalambika Ningaiah, Shivamma Nanjaiah Nanjaiah, Nagaveni Bhyra, Kiranmayee Muralidhar, Purnima Madhivanan, Karl Krupp
pmc-10737957.description: Hypertension, a major risk for cardiovascular and cerebrovascular diseases, affects 1.3 billion globally and 229 million in India. While exercise has shown to lower blood pressure, 40% of older Indians report inadequate physical activity. Inspiratory Muscle Strength Training (IMST), a novel breathing exercise, shows promise for controlling hypertension, but little is known about its acceptability among older Indian adults.

pmc-10875082.title: Glucocorticoid-induced osteoporosis is prevented by dietary prune in female mice
pmc-10875082.creator: Nicholas J. Chargo, Kerri Neugebauer, Douglas V. Guzior, Robert A. Quinn, Narayanan Parameswaran, Laura R. McCabe
pmc-10875082.description: Glucocorticoid-induced osteoporosis (GIO) is a significant side effect of prolonged glucocorticoid (GC) treatment. Chronic GC treatment also leads to trabecular bone loss and gut microbiota dysbiosis in mice. The gut dysbiosis is mechanistically linked to GIO, which indicates that the microbiota can be targeted to prevent GIO.

pmc-12514590.title: Weak redundancy U-shaped network and heatmap-based object prompt method for real-time medical image processing
pmc-12514590.creator: Chenzhuo Lu, Zhuang Fu, Ziwen Guo, Jian Fei, Rongli Xie
pmc-12514590.description: BackgroundIn recent years, artificial intelligence (AI) technology has experienced significant growth, leading to the development of advanced tools that assist radiologists in image interpretation and diagnostic decision-making. In the field of medical image processing, object detection and segmentation are crucial research areas. Achieving automatic and rapid segmentation of organs and lesions can significantly enhance physicians’ work efficiency.

pmc-12626165.title: Nose‐to‐Brain Delivery of Chlorella vulgaris Extracellular Vesicles for Antidepressant Effects
pmc-12626165.creator: Kangyu Jin, Ruoxi Wang, Bing Chen, Danni Zhong, Shangping Cheng, Aiying Tong, Yangjian Qi, Jing Lu, Min Zhou
pmc-12626165.description: Current antidepressants face limitations due to the blood–brain barrier (BBB), systemic side effects and delayed onset. Here, we engineered an intranasal thermosensitive hydrogel (EVs@IN) encapsulating Chlorella vulgaris‐derived extracellular vesicles (EVs) for sustained nose‐to‐brain delivery. EVs@IN significantly enhanced nasal mucosal retention and facilitated targeted transport of EVs to the hippocampus via olfactory pathways, while minimizing pulmonary exposure and clearance.

pmc-12678250.title: Maternal syphilis in the Federal District, Brazil: a five-year analysis of notified data (2019–2023)
pmc-12678250.creator: Paula Beatriz de Medeiros Santiago, Maria Eduarda Santiago Meneses, Luiza de Lima Pereira, Maria Fernanda Santiago Meneses, Pamela Araújo da Silva, Fabiana Nunes de Carvalho Mariz, Ciro Martins Gomes, Carla Nunes de Araújo
pmc-12678250.description: Syphilis, caused by the bacterium Treponema pallidum, is among the most prevalent STIs globally and represents a significant public health challenge in Brazil. Vertical transmission can occur at any stage of pregnancy, leading to severe consequences such as miscarriage, stillbirth, preterm birth, and low birth weight.

pmc-13301414.title: An ultrasimplified technique to perform cardioneuroablation: results from a prospective observational study
pmc-13301414.creator: J Jabbour, C Sportouch, M Pons, F Raczka, N Clementy
pmc-13301414.description: BackgroundCardioneuroablation (CNA) has emerged as a promising therapeutic strategy for patients with reflex syncope. However, current approaches remain technically complex and heterogeneous.PurposeTo prospectively evaluate the feasibility, efficacy, and safety of an ultrasimplified CNA protocol in reducing reflex syncope recurrence.MethodsTwenty-six patients (mean age 43.9 ± 16.4 years) with ≥3 reflex syncope episodes in the previous 12 months underwent CNA.

pmc-13679003.creator: Liying Zhang, Shiyin Li, Xiaomeng Ma, Shimei Cheng, Ziying Ye, Shuhua Liu, Luping Qin, Huimin Dong, Yifeng Feng, Mingyue Li, Jinghui Xu, Lei Cai, Xiquan Hu, Xiaofei He
pmc-13679003.description: BackgroundAutophagy-lysosomal dysfunction contributes to lipid droplet (LD) accumulation, which drives pathological progression in Alzheimer's disease (AD). Exercise is reported to restore autophagy-lysosomal function and attenuate cognitive impairment in AD, but its regulation of LD deposition remains unknown.Methods5×FAD transgenic mice underwent a three-month exercise intervention.

pmc-7616199.title: Ecosystem Resilience of a South African Mesic Grassland with Change from Rotational to Continuous Grazing
pmc-7616199.creator: Nomusa Chonco, Rob Slotow, Zivanai Tsvuura, Sindiso Nkuna
pmc-7616199.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Grazing practices affect the soil and vegetation of grasslands, which further influence the provision of ecosystem services and the productivity of grasslands. We determined the ecosystem resilience of a mesic grassland under three grazing management systems in the Pakkies area, (30°33′08′′S, 29°25′22′′ E), South Africa: cooperative (continuously grazed since 2017), commercial (rotationally grazed for >20 years), and communal (continuously grazed for >20 years) farms.

Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel.
